title: Pirating the Pirates: Anghami's Paid-For Launch in Lebanon
conflicts: Early users: Wamda (Feb 2013) half a million in three months vs Communicate (2021) over a million in three months against an expected 300,000 (and a WSJ-cited one million in four months); the story uses the contemporary half-million. Funding timing: BBC says first $1m investment in 2011, TNW says MEVP backing in March 2012, Daily Star says a $1m round announced Nov 2012; story says only $1m by November 2012. Idea origin: BBC 2010 notebook vs Wamda 2011 ski trip; story uses the first-hand BBC account. Daily Star's 'launched in March' conflicts with Wamda's 5 November 2012 public launch; story follows Wamda.
notes: Quote contains Confucius's 'Sell it! Sell it!' (exclamation marks are in Legge's text, not the edition's voice). Stance: complicates. The 2012 office was in Jounieh, so the title says Lebanon rather than Beirut.
